newsitem.title: MEXICO: Apasco says deal to supply Tribasa.
newsitem.headline: Apasco says deal to supply Tribasa.

text.p: Mexico cement-maker Apasco has reached agreement to supply highway projects by construction firm Grupo Tribasa, a senior company executive said in a conference call.
"We closed some deals for a very important amount of cement which is to be consumed between May and October," said Carlos Buhler, Apasco Chief Financial Officer.
Buhler added Apasco would also supply Tribasa with cement to lay hydraulic concrete surfacing on high-specification highways.

The highway contract with Tribasa, and other similar "less vital" projects, would allow Apasco to recoup the two-percentage-point loss in market share the company suffered in the first quarter of 1997, Buhler said.
